mapper.select: SELECT e.shop_group_id, e.user_id, e.name, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM shop_group e LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.target_type = 'SHOP_GROUP' AND t.target_id = e.shop_group_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.shop_group_id

SELECT e.shop_group_id, e.user_id, e.name, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM shop_group e LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.target_type = 'SHOP_GROUP' AND t.target_id = e.shop_group_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.shop_group_id = #{shopGroupId}

SELECT e.shop_group_id, e.user_id, e.name, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM shop_group e LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.target_type = 'SHOP_GROUP' AND t.target_id = e.shop_group_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_group (user_id, name, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_group SET name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_group_id = #{shopGroupId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shop_group WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_group_id = #{shopGroupId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.shop_id FROM shop c JOIN shop_group p ON p.shop_group_id = c.shop_group_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.name = #{defaultName} AND c.name = #{defaultName}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT figure_id) FROM figure WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_id IN (SELECT shop_id FROM shop WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_group_id = #{shopGroupId})
